body:
Hi team,

I was reading through the Georgia Roof Advisors homepage and spotted something you may not have noticed. Your newsletter section still has lorem ipsum placeholder text in it, repeated month after month, and one banner says over 230+ reviews while another says 520+. Small things, but homeowners reading closely notice them.

The shell of the site looks modern. It just has unfinished template pieces left live, which undercuts the trust you are working hard to build.

So I went ahead and mocked up the cleaned up homepage, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. The placeholder text is gone, your reviews tell one consistent story, and your GAF Master Elite standing gets the prominence it should have had all along.

I redesign sites for home service companies, and I would start by cleaning up exactly those rough edges and making the reviews story consistent. A couple of roofing sites I built: Leal Roofing (leal-roofing.com), simple and fast with the phone number always in reach, and Severe Weather Roofing (severeweatherroofing.com), built around storm work and quick quotes.

If you like the direction, I can apply the same cleanup across the full site. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Georgia Roof Advisors
subject: 🏠 Your newsletter section still has lorem ipsum on it
